edge.note: Local date 20 Nov, UTC date 21 Nov
edge.text: Peru magnitude 6.7 quake: struck 19:09 local Fri 20 Nov, which is 00:09 UTC Sat 21 Nov; reported worldwide as a 20 Nov story

left_out.text: World Court finds Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
Trump, Xi and Putin hold first-ever three-way summit in Shenzhen
Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth
Kenya discharges its last Ebola patient, 37 days after its first case

not_yet.text: BepiColombo spacecraft enters orbit around Mercury
NATO chief Mark Rutte due in Warsaw after Poland missile incident

markets.note: S&P 500 6,910, down 3.7%; Nasdaq down 5.3%; Nikkei down 5.06%; Brent crude $89.87; gold down about 4%; Bitcoin down 4.15%.

sports.note: Alcaraz beat Cobolli at the ATP Finals in Turin; A Lim Kim aced the 16th to lead the LPGA finale; Lauren Price became undisputed welterweight champion; James Harden posted his 50th 50-point game as the Cavaliers beat the Pacers 128-119.

stories.dek: Two Russian missiles and a suspected drone came down in eastern Poland during NATO drills nearby; PM Tusk called it a likely deliberate provocation and NATO called it a grave violation of airspace.
stories.headline: Russian missiles land in Poland

stories.dek: Russia fired more than 400 drones and 110 missiles at Ukraine overnight, killing at least eight in Kyiv, hitting bridges and rail stations and cutting power in ten regions.
stories.headline: Russia strikes Kyiv bridges in overnight attack

stories.dek: US stocks fell sharply on Friday as an AI and chip sell-off pushed the S&P 500 down 3.7% to 6,910 and the Nasdaq down 5.3%, wiping out the Nasdaq's 2026 gains.
stories.headline: S&P 500 and Dow slide into correction as AI stocks fall

stories.dek: The UN climate summit in Antalya ran past its Friday deadline after a revised draft deal removed every mention of phasing out fossil fuels and dropped a $120bn adaptation finance figure.
stories.headline: COP31 runs into overtime as draft drops fossil fuels

stories.dek: PM Andy Burnham signed three agreements with EU leaders covering food exports, linked carbon markets and a youth mobility scheme for 18- to 31-year-olds.
stories.headline: UK and EU sign post-Brexit deals in Brussels

stories.dek: A ninth informal straw poll on Friday left every candidate for UN secretary-general blocked by at least one veto; frontrunner Rebeca Grynspan won 10 encourage votes but drew four discourages, two from veto powers.
stories.headline: UN secretary-general race stalls after ninth vote

stories.dek: Trump said he may not decide the next Iran step until 2027; a tanker caught fire near the Strait of Hormuz and the US sanctioned four Iranians over oil revenues.
stories.headline: Iran war nears ninth month as Trump says he is in no rush

stories.dek: The Saudi-led coalition struck Hodeidah port on Friday after intercepting five Houthi drones and a ballistic missile, and warned airlines and ships to avoid Yemeni ports and airports.
stories.headline: Saudi-led coalition strikes Hodeidah port after Houthi attacks

stories.dek: A magnitude 6.7 quake struck near Cerro de Pasco in central Peru at 19:09 local time, shaking buildings in Lima as people evacuated; no tsunami was expected.
stories.headline: Magnitude 6.7 earthquake hits central Peru

stories.dek: A Los Angeles jury found Jonathan Rinderknecht guilty of arson in the Palisades Fire, which killed a dozen people and burned more than 23,000 acres; he faces up to 20 years per offence.
stories.headline: Jury convicts man of starting deadly Palisades Fire

stories.dek: A trial of the pill daraxonrasib stopped tumours growing in nearly all participants and made cancer undetectable in one in 12 patients, in a 61-person trial.
stories.headline: Pill shows promise against pancreatic cancer

stories.dek: President Trump said US tech firms that build AI data centres overseas will face a tremendous tax, speaking at a 90-minute White House press conference after his China trip.
stories.headline: Trump threatens tax on firms building AI data centres abroad

stories.dek: US lawmakers released confidential chip-export licensing records, adding to pressure on Nvidia, which fell 14% on Friday; California is investigating whether its chips reached China.
stories.headline: Nvidia under more pressure as chip export records released

stories.dek: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr returned to Manila on Friday evening from the APEC summit in Shenzhen with P41.1 billion in investment pledges that could create more than 7,000 jobs.
stories.headline: Marcos returns from APEC with P41.1bn in investment pledges

stories.dek: Gaza's civil defence said Israeli strikes killed six people on Friday, and Israeli troops crossed the Yellow Line in central Gaza to dismantle a tunnel, displacing thousands near Nuseirat.
stories.headline: Israeli strikes kill Palestinians in Gaza as ceasefire frays

stories.dek: Thousands of students marched across Europe over living costs, tuition and military spending, with tens of thousands in Switzerland and thousands in Berlin; Italy held a general strike.
stories.headline: Gen Z protests sweep 25 European countries

stories.dek: Lufthansa told staff on Friday it plans to cut up to 1,000 jobs at its Frankfurt and Munich hubs, citing high fuel costs and a 180 million euro nine-month loss at its mainline airline.
stories.headline: Lufthansa to cut up to 1,000 jobs as fuel costs bite

stories.dek: Denmark charged two men and expelled Russia's defence attache over an alleged plot to kill Ukrainian-American rapper Kyivstoner, which Copenhagen blames on Russian intelligence.
stories.headline: Denmark expels Russian diplomat over alleged plot to kill rapper

stories.dek: Estonia will shut its five road checkpoints with Russia from 1 December, citing an attempted arson at a defence company it blames on Russian intelligence.
stories.headline: Estonia to close Russia border crossings after sabotage attack

stories.dek: French authorities opened an investigation into actor Gerard Depardieu and author Michel Houellebecq over sexual allegations.
stories.headline: France investigates Depardieu and Houellebecq over alleged gang rape

stories.dek: Cyclone Akvan crossed the North Andhra Pradesh and South Odisha coast near Gopalpur on Friday morning with winds of 70-80 kmph gusting to 90, after around 300,000 people were evacuated and 69 trains cancelled.
stories.headline: Cyclone Akvan makes landfall on India's east coast

stories.dek: A Cabinet Office survey released on Friday found 93% of Japanese say relations with China are poor or somewhat poor, the worst reading since the question began in 1986, with 93.7% also negative on Russia.
stories.headline: Japan-China ties at record low, survey finds

stories.dek: Japan's core inflation rose to its highest this year as energy subsidies expired, though below the 2.3% forecast, keeping a Bank of Japan rate hike in view.
stories.headline: Japan's core inflation rises to year high

stories.dek: Japan will buy up to 8 million barrels of Saudi crude to refill reserves drawn down during the Hormuz crisis.
stories.headline: Saudi Arabia and Japan agree oil stockpile deal

stories.dek: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said on Friday that India's first bullet train service will start in the last quarter of 2027 on the Surat-Vapi section of the 508-km Mumbai-Ahmedabad line, using an indigenous trainset capable of 280 kmph.
stories.headline: India's first bullet train to run from late 2027, minister says

stories.dek: Nepal's PM will make his first India trip on 22-23 November, with trade and connectivity on the agenda and several agreements expected.
stories.headline: Nepal's PM Balendra Shah to make first India visit

stories.dek: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani unveiled a plan on Friday to close the Rikers Island jail complex by 2032, replacing it with four borough-based jails - the first in Brooklyn in 2029 - backed by $146 million in investment.
stories.headline: Mamdani unveils plan to close Rikers Island by 2032

stories.dek: A Missouri judge approved Bayer's $7.25 billion payout to settle about 65,000 claims that Roundup weedkiller causes cancer; Bayer admits no wrongdoing.
stories.headline: Judge approves $7.25 billion Bayer settlement over Roundup

stories.dek: Nikhil Gupta was sentenced on Friday in a Manhattan federal court to 235 months in prison for a murder-for-hire plot targeting Sikh separatist Gurpatwant Singh Pannun in New York.
stories.headline: Nikhil Gupta sentenced to 19½ years over murder-for-hire plot

stories.dek: The White House announced on Friday that Kirsten Davies, the Defense Department's chief information officer, will be the new national cyber director, succeeding Sean Cairncross.
stories.headline: White House names Kirsten Davies as new cyber director

stories.dek: President Trump said on Friday he is working on a fair trade deal with Canada but that more work remains before it can be reached.
stories.headline: Trump says more work to be done on fair Canada trade deal

stories.dek: An explosion and smoke seen on Iran's Qeshm Island were caused by disposal of unexploded munitions, the Tasnim news agency reported, after earlier reporting a missile strike there.
stories.headline: Blast on Iran's Qeshm Island blamed on munitions disposal

stories.dek: Iraqi police and state-backed forces entered Jurf al-Nasr south of Baghdad, in what the PM called the start of a push to assert state control over militia-held areas.
stories.headline: Iraqi forces enter Jurf al-Nasr for first time in 12 years

stories.dek: President Trump told reporters at the White House on Friday that Iran wants to make a deal, 'but they don't want to make a deal that's acceptable to me', as the standoff over its nuclear programme continued.
stories.headline: Trump says Iran wants a deal but not one he will accept

stories.dek: The US Treasury said on Friday it sanctioned four Iranians it calls 'oil trustees' for collecting illicit oil-sale revenues to evade sanctions and the US naval blockade, as part of Operation Economic Outcast.
stories.headline: US sanctions four Iranians accused of running oil revenue network

stories.dek: A boat carrying mourners overturned in Bayelsa State, Nigeria; police confirmed at least four dead, while one report said about 30 were dead and 300 missing.
stories.headline: Boat carrying funeral mourners capsizes in Nigeria

stories.dek: Kenya spudded its first commercial oil well at the Amosing 1 pad in Turkana on Friday, with Energy Cabinet Secretary Opiyo Wandayi presiding; first commercial oil is targeted for 1 December, starting at 20,000 barrels a day.
stories.headline: Kenya begins drilling first commercial oil well in Turkana

stories.dek: Acting Police Minister Firoz Cachalia presented quarterly crime statistics on Friday showing 5,590 murders in July-September, more than 1,600 fewer than a year earlier, though 581 women were killed in the same period.
stories.headline: South Africa murders fall by more than 1,600 in a quarter

stories.dek: Tribes in southern Egypt handed over 33 automatic rifles and two machine guns on 20 November in the first phase of a weapons-collection drive tied to a presidential initiative to legalise informal gold prospectors in the Eastern Desert.
stories.headline: Egyptian tribes hand over rifles in gold-mining amnesty

stories.dek: Sports Minister Kofi Adams told parliament on Friday that Ghana spent $4.67 million of a $5 million advance on its 2026 World Cup campaign, which ended in the round of 32 with a 1-0 defeat to Colombia.
stories.headline: Ghana reveals $4.67m spent on World Cup campaign

stories.dek: About 300 migrants, mostly from Central America, crossed into southern Mexico early on Friday and joined a larger caravan of around 1,500 people heading north, the seventh such group to enter Chiapas this year.
stories.headline: New migrant caravan enters southern Mexico

stories.dek: Chilean President Jose Antonio Kast said on Friday after meeting Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi in Tokyo that Chile will seek stronger cooperation on critical minerals, including copper.
stories.headline: Chile and Japan to boost critical-minerals cooperation

stories.dek: Argentina's country risk topped 1,000 points as bonds sold off; separately, Argentina approved a large LNG investment.
stories.headline: Argentina's bonds slide into distress

stories.dek: Acting President Delcy Rodriguez said on Friday that Venezuela rejects the jurisdiction of the International Court of Justice over the Esequibo territory and urged Guyana to honour the 1966 Geneva Agreement.
stories.headline: Venezuela rejects world court role in Esequibo dispute

stories.dek: Rockstar and Take-Two said on Friday that Grand Theft Auto VI took $3.79 billion in day-one retail sales, the biggest entertainment launch in history, after 32.5 million pre-orders.
stories.headline: GTA VI sets record as biggest entertainment launch ever

stories.dek: Claim: Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge says he has, working with Claude, discovered a proof of the Riemann hypothesis; not independently verified or peer-reviewed.
stories.headline: Anthropic researcher claims Claude helped prove Riemann hypothesis
